filesystem_reconciliation.qualification: CP76 ordinary Qt/helper native writes/readback cover all seven at 512/512, 512/4096 and 4096/4096, rotating MBR/GPT/SFD. Sparse component fixtures cover capacity/cluster boundaries. This is not every filesystem/layout/capacity Cartesian combination.
filesystem_reconciliation.dormant_ext4: E01: no enabled original Windows data-format selection; ext4 persistence is separately supported.

layout_and_firmware.policy: Only original source/filesystem/capacity eligible combinations are offered. SFD and non-512-byte boot limits are intentional provider limits; there is no promise that every boot choice supports every layout or filesystem.
layout_and_firmware.512e: 512-byte logical/4096-byte physical media uses 512-byte filesystem blocks; CP76 freezes and independently checks both facts.
layout_and_firmware.4kn: Native data formatting and FAT UEFI are qualified under emulation. Original BIOS/DOS/Syslinux/SBR and bundled UEFI:NTFS retain their executable 512-byte contract and refuse unsupported logical sectors before writes.
layout_and_firmware.ntfs_4kn: NTFS-3G is selected before partitioning for 4096-byte logical-sector file creation; no fallback after I/O errors. 512/512 and 512e prefer the kernel provider.
